stories.title: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DR Congo spreads to two more health zones
stories.summary: WHO reports 7,890 confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths, with Ituri province still the epicentre. It is the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record and remains a public health emergency of international concern.
stories.source: WHO Disease Outbreak News

stories.title: Bangladesh's measles outbreak tops 184,000 suspected cases
stories.summary: Nearly 21,000 cases are confirmed and 980 deaths have been reported among suspected cases since mid-March. All eight divisions are affected, with Dhaka hit hardest.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Guatemala's measles epidemic reaches every department
stories.summary: 33,746 confirmed cases and 45 deaths since December 2025, in an outbreak linked to a religious retreat. Guatemala City has the most cases, though incidence is now falling.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Mexico's largest measles epidemic since 1997 passes 13,000 cases this year
stories.summary: 31 states have reported cases in 2026, led by Jalisco. Mexico's measles elimination status will be reviewed in November.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Pennsylvania reports a fourth measles-related death
stories.summary: It is the most measles deaths in the US in a single year since 1992. The US has confirmed more than 3,400 cases in 2026, already well above all of last year.
stories.source: CNN

stories.title: Lassa fever cases stay high in Nigeria
stories.summary: 7,938 suspected and 1,086 confirmed cases with 259 deaths across 24 states this year. Ondo, Bauchi, Taraba and Edo are most affected.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Chikungunya passes 200,000 cases in the Americas
stories.summary: Brazil accounts for nearly 128,000 cases, followed by Bolivia and Argentina. Regional numbers are now declining.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Florida's local dengue cases keep climbing
stories.summary: 183 locally acquired cases have been reported in Florida this year, with Hillsborough County called the epicentre. Puerto Rico and American Samoa also report local spread.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Bangladesh records 65,000 dengue hospital admissions
stories.summary: 195 people have died of dengue across all eight divisions this year, on top of the country's measles outbreak.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Sri Lanka passes 99,000 dengue cases
stories.summary: 76 deaths have been reported this year, though weekly cases have been falling since a July peak.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Mpox outbreak across nine health zones in Kasaï, DR Congo
stories.summary: 77 suspected cases, 16 confirmed by laboratory and three deaths have been reported.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Mpox cluster in South Africa linked to international travel
stories.summary: Cases have been found in several provinces, with the Western Cape at the centre. The virus clade is still being confirmed.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Bangladesh confirms its fourth human bird flu (H5N1) case this year
stories.summary: The latest case is a child in Rangpur Division. One of the four people has died.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: New World screwworm reaches 692 human cases in Mexico
stories.summary: More than 44,000 animal cases have been reported since late 2024, and the flesh-eating parasite is moving north into cities.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Screwworm reaches New Mexico
stories.summary: A horse became the second equine case in the US and the first in New Mexico, bringing confirmed US animal cases to 50.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Japanese encephalitis deaths push Nepal's Jhapa district to the centre of a vaccination drive
stories.summary: Six of ten people infected in Jhapa have died. Nationally, Nepal's season has since passed 120 cases and 26 deaths, all among unvaccinated people.
stories.source: Kathmandu Post

stories.title: Leptospirosis passes 10,900 cases in the Philippines
stories.summary: Epidemic thresholds have been exceeded in parts of 10 regions after heavy rains and flooding.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Suspected yellow fever outbreak in northern Ghana
stories.summary: 21 deaths have been reported among the Fulbe nomadic community in Sissala East.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Cholera outbreak among Kenyatta University students
stories.summary: The outbreak has been linked to a market near the Nairobi campus.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: California sees a five-year high in West Nile virus
stories.summary: 147 cases and 10 deaths so far, with Los Angeles County hit hardest.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: 36 deaths under investigation in Ifanadiana, Madagascar
stories.summary: Measles and malaria are suspected and health agencies are waiting on test results.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Severe botulism cases in Denmark after cosmetic injections
stories.summary: Six people became seriously ill after cosmetic or excessive-sweating treatments. The source has not been confirmed.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Thailand makes tick-borne SFTS a notifiable disease
stories.summary: Three cases of severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome, including two deaths, have been reported in 2026.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Wild polio cases continue in Afghanistan and Pakistan
stories.summary: 36 cases of wild poliovirus type 1 have been reported in 2026, all from the last two countries where it still circulates.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Australia's diphtheria surge slowly eases
stories.summary: 560 cases this year, a 41-fold rise over the recent average. Nearly all are in remote parts of the Northern Territory and Western Australia.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Malaria resurges in Mayotte
stories.summary: 349 confirmed cases this year, the most since 2010. Most are imported from Comoros, but local transmission continues in the island's south.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Anthrax kills 60 wild animals and infects 12 people in Zambia
stories.summary: The outbreak is in a game management area in Mpika District, Muchinga Province.
stories.source: Global News

stories.title: Legionnaires' disease cluster in the South Bronx
stories.summary: New York City's health department is investigating a community cluster and testing cooling towers.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: South Korea issues an early flu epidemic warning
stories.summary: Flu illness and hospitalisations are rising ahead of the national vaccination rollout.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Indonesia's worst fire season in years sickens 170,000
stories.summary: El Niño and peatland clearing have burned close to 900,000 hectares, with South Papua worst hit. Haze is drifting to Malaysia, Singapore, the Philippines and Thailand.
stories.source: Malay Mail

stories.title: A strengthening El Niño raises health risks across the Americas
stories.summary: PAHO warns of more dengue and other mosquito-borne diseases, food insecurity, floods and drought, and urges countries to prepare health services now.
stories.source: PAHO

stories.title: WHO publishes guidance on heat illness at mass gatherings
stories.summary: New reviews and practical advice for keeping crowds safe at festivals, pilgrimages and sporting events as heatwaves intensify.
stories.source: WHO

stories.title: Methanol-laced drinks kill 48 in Nigeria's Ondo State
stories.summary: 182 people fell ill in Odigbo and Irele after drinking alcohol later found to contain high levels of methanol.
stories.source: KSAT / Associated Press

stories.title: West Nile virus pushes north in Europe
stories.summary: The Netherlands has 28 locally acquired cases and four deaths this year, and Europe's season is above the decade average. Blood safety measures have been expanded.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Cholera returns as floods displace 470,000 in Myanmar
stories.summary: Acute watery diarrhoea is spreading in flood-hit Sagaing, Mandalay and Bago, where health services are already weakened by years of conflict.
stories.source: Burma News International

stories.title: Cholera and displacement surge across Sudan as aid runs short
stories.summary: More than 2,600 cholera cases have been reported and fighting in Kordofan keeps forcing families from their homes. The humanitarian appeal is only 41% funded.
stories.source: Sudan Tribune

stories.title: Unexplained illness among children in North Darfur
stories.summary: Health agencies are seeking test results for a cluster of sick children as conflict limits access to care.
stories.source: NY State Dept. of Health, Global Health Update

stories.title: Fiji declares HIV a national emergency
stories.summary: About 1 in 60 adults now live with HIV, driven partly by injecting drug use. The declaration expands testing, prevention and treatment.
stories.source: WHO

stories.title: Countries wrap up another round of talks on the Pandemic Agreement
stories.summary: Negotiators worked on the annex on sharing pathogen samples and the vaccines and medicines that come from them, which the agreement needs before it can take effect.
stories.source: Healthcare Middle East & Africa

stories.title: Gilead expands generic licensing for a once-a-year HIV prevention shot
stories.summary: The deal lets generic makers prepare to produce an investigational yearly lenacapavir injection, building on the twice-yearly version already approved.
stories.source: Global Health Technologies Coalition

stories.title: WHO publishes a handbook for reducing alcohol harm
stories.summary: The SAFER handbook gives countries practical steps for putting proven alcohol policies into action.
stories.source: WHO

stories.title: Five countries in the Americas recognised for eliminating diseases
stories.summary: Brazil, Chile, El Salvador, The Bahamas and Turks and Caicos were honoured at PAHO's Directing Council. Chile is the first country in the Americas verified for eliminating leprosy.
stories.source: PAHO

stories.title: Timor-Leste eliminates trachoma
stories.summary: WHO has validated that trachoma, the world's leading infectious cause of blindness, is no longer a public health problem in Timor-Leste.
stories.source: WHO

stories.title: WHO adds the first malaria medicine made for newborns to its guidelines
stories.summary: Coartem Baby treats babies weighing 2 to 5 kg, who until now had no approved option, and is rolling out in 11 countries.
stories.source: Global Health Technologies Coalition

stories.title: Tunisia eliminates trachoma
stories.summary: WHO validated Tunisia as having eliminated trachoma as a public health problem.
stories.source: WHO

stories.title: Australia becomes the 30th country to eliminate trachoma
stories.summary: The milestone follows decades of work with Aboriginal communities on face washing, antibiotics and better housing.
stories.source: WHO

stories.title: FDA approves the first mRNA flu vaccine
stories.summary: Moderna's mFlusiva uses the same mRNA platform as its COVID vaccine and can be updated faster than egg-grown flu shots.
stories.source: CNN

stories.title: AI heart monitor launches in India
stories.summary: Czech company Kardi Ai is bringing a wearable ECG chest strap with AI analysis to India to catch irregular heart rhythms that short tests miss.
stories.source: Telangana Today

stories.title: South Africa moves AI diagnostics from pilots into everyday care
stories.summary: Providers now have to show clinical value and regulatory compliance as AI tools for reading scans and tests enter routine practice.
stories.source: Lifestyle & Tech

stories.title: Study finds no evidence of an autism epidemic
stories.summary: Following more than 62,000 South Korean children across 12 birth cohorts, researchers found autism prevalence stayed stable. They say rising diagnoses reflect better detection.
stories.source: Healio

stories.title: One in eight cancers worldwide is caused by an infection
stories.summary: A Lancet Oncology study links 2.3 million new cancers a year to infections, led by H. pylori and HPV. In India, HPV alone accounts for over 100,000 cases, mostly cervical cancer.
stories.source: Business Today

stories.title: More than 1 in 10 US healthcare workers have lasting long-COVID symptoms
stories.summary: A University of Iowa-led study of nearly 1,500 health workers in 17 states found fatigue was the most common ongoing symptom.
stories.source: CIDRAP

stories.title: CEPI funds research to fight the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak
stories.summary: $3.9 million goes to projects led by Congo's national biomedical research institute, Imperial College London and Makerere University.
stories.source: Global Health Technologies Coalition

stories.title: Nearly 1.5 million people displaced in Haiti as violence spreads
stories.summary: The UN says armed-group violence keeps pushing families from their homes, making it harder to reach clinics and clean water.
stories.source: US News / Reuters
